sources.entry: Muse - Spotify controller with TouchBar support.

summary.one_liner: Muse is an open-source macOS app that controls Spotify, iTunes and Vox playback from the Touch Bar and a global hotkey window.
summary.what_it_does: Muse adds a permanent button to the Touch Bar control strip that shows album art and playback time; tapping it reveals the full control bar, long-pressing toggles play/pause, and swiping skips tracks. A global hotkey (control + command + s) shows a centered album art window with playback controls. It also offers system-wide now playing controls from the leftmost control strip button, similar to iTunes and Safari. It automatically guesses which supported player (Spotify, iTunes or Vox) to control, and keyboard shortcuts handle play/pause, previous/next, repeat, shuffle, liking a track, and switching players. Spotify account login is optional and enables adding or removing favourites.
use_cases: control Spotify from the MacBook Touch Bar
control iTunes or Vox playback with a hotkey
see album art and track info in a floating window
skip, pause or like songs without switching apps
add or remove Spotify favourites from the desktop
how_to_run: git clone && cd Muse/ && pod install && open Muse.xcworkspace
notable: Permanent Touch Bar control strip button showing album art and playback time
System-wide now playing controls like iTunes and Safari
Global hotkey window with album art display
Auto-detects the active player among Spotify, iTunes and Vox
caveats: Requires a Mac with a Touch Bar for the Touch Bar features
App is not code signed, so macOS Gatekeeper must be bypassed manually
Spotify login is optional and only needed for library favourites
